provenance.fact_exempt_rule: The walked renders are an ARCHITECTURE AND REGISTER reference only. No fact, name, figure, entity or scenario from them may reach a customer document, and none of them may be seeded into a fixture as record truth.

thesis: This assessment states, once, whether the business's cybersecurity programme is audit-ready under 11 CCR §§ 7121-7124 on the record it supplied, and then shows the record that produced that answer component by component. Arithmetic about the eighteen § 7123(c) components belongs in the typed control tally the renderer prints, never in a sentence; comparative frameworks are named as comparative and never as the operative requirement.

sections.title: The programme as the business described it
The eighteen components, one at a time
When the first audit is due
What the record does not yet carry, and what closes it

exemplars.before: This readiness assessment rates Meridian SaaS Inc. Mean of 81 across the 17 scored components (excluding 1 Insufficient-information component).
exemplars.after: The programme is not yet audit-ready on this record. Seventeen of the eighteen § 7123(c) components are scored; the tally and its denominator are set out in the component table.
exemplars.rule: Prose states the verdict. Arithmetic lives in the typed control tally and is formatted by the renderer.

exemplars.rule: A comparative framework is named as comparative. Framework function names are proper nouns and are never rewritten as operative verbs.

exemplars.after: The record documents multi-factor authentication for all administrative access and supplies the configuration export that evidences it. What remains is retention of the change-log evidence for the audit period; the operative requirement is 11 CCR § 7123(c)(2).
exemplars.rule: Credit first, then the incremental residual, then the operative pinpoint once.
